title.zh: 卷八十四 志第三十四: 選舉四
title.raw: 卷八十四 志第三十四: 選舉四 Volume 84 Treatises 37: Selection of Officials 4

sentences.zh: 選舉四 ○考課

translations.literal: Selection of Officials 4 ○ Merit Examination
translations.idiomatic: Selection of Officials, Part Four — Merit Examination

sentences.zh: 凡隨朝職官：至元六年格，一考升一等，兩考通升二等止。

translations.literal: As for officials who attend court: In the regulations of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, one examination period raises one grade; two examination periods in total raise two grades, and no more.
translations.idiomatic: For officials serving at court: under the regulations of Zhiyuan 6 (1269), one merit review advances one rank, and two reviews together advance two ranks at most.

sentences.zh: 六部侍郎正四品，依舊例通理八十月，升三品。

translations.literal: Vice ministers of the Six Ministries, rank 4a, according to the old precedent count eighty months in total and are promoted to rank 3.
translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers of the Six Ministries (rank 4a) are promoted to rank 3 after a combined total of eighty months of service, as under the former rule.

sentences.zh: 左右司郎中、員外郎、都事，考滿升二等。

translations.literal: Directors, vice directors, and chief clerks of the Left and Right Offices, upon completing their examination period, are promoted two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Directors, vice directors, and chief clerks in the Left and Right Secretariat offices advance two ranks upon completing their review.

sentences.zh: 六部郎中、員外郎、主事，三十月考滿升一等，兩考通升二等。

translations.literal: Directors, vice directors, and section chiefs of the Six Ministries, upon completing thirty months' examination, are promoted one grade; two examination periods in total raise two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Directors, vice directors, and section chiefs in the Six Ministries advance one rank after a thirty-month review and two ranks after two reviews combined.

sentences.zh: 凡官員考數：省部定擬：從九品擬歷三任，升從八。

translations.literal: As for the number of examinations for officials: The Secretariat and ministries fixed the rules: Those of rank 9b are to serve three terms and be promoted to rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: On the number of reviews required for promotion, the central ministries prescribed: officials at rank 9b must complete three terms before advancing to rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 正九品歷兩任，升從八。

translations.literal: Rank 9a, after two terms, is promoted to rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 9a officials advance to rank 8b after two terms.

sentences.zh: 正八品歷三任，升從七。

translations.literal: Rank 8a, after three terms, is promoted to rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 8a officials advance to rank 7b after three terms.

sentences.zh: 從七歷三任，呈省。

translations.literal: Rank 7b, after three terms, is submitted to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 7b officials, after three terms, are referred to the Secretariat for decision.

sentences.zh: 正七歷兩任，升從六。

translations.literal: Rank 7a, after two terms, is promoted to rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 7a officials advance to rank 6b after two terms.

sentences.zh: 從六品通歷三任，升從五。

translations.literal: Rank 6b, in total after three terms, is promoted to rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6b officials advance to rank 5b after three terms in all.

sentences.zh: 正六歷兩任，升從五。

translations.literal: Rank 6a, after two terms, is promoted to rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 6a officials advance to rank 5b after two terms.

sentences.zh: 從五轉至正五，緣四品闕少，通歷兩任，須歷上州尹一任，方入四品。

translations.literal: From rank 5b to rank 5a: because vacancies at rank 4 are few, after two terms in total one must serve one term as prefect of an upper prefecture before entering rank 4.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion from rank 5b to 5a: because fourth-rank posts are scarce, after two terms one must also serve as prefect of an upper prefecture before entering the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 內外正從四品，通理八十月，升三品。

translations.literal: Ranks 4a and 4b, interior and exterior, count eighty months in total and are promoted to rank 3.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-rank officials, whether in the capital or in the provinces, are promoted to rank 3 after a combined total of eighty months.

sentences.zh: 凡取會行止：中統三年，詔置簿立式，取會各官姓名、籍貫、年甲、入仕次第。

translations.literal: As for gathering and checking conduct records: In the third year of Zhongtong, an edict established the register format, gathering each official's name, native place, age, and order of entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: On verifying officials' conduct records: in Zhongtong 3 (1262) an edict established a register format requiring each official's name, birthplace, age, and sequence of appointments.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，諸職官解由到省部，考其功過，以憑黜陟。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, when all officials' credentials upon leaving office reached the Secretariat and ministries, their merits and faults were examined as the basis for demotion and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 (1282), when officials' departure credentials reached the central ministries, their performance was reviewed to determine promotions and dismissals.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，外任官解由到吏部，止於刑部照過，將各人所歷，立行止簿，就檢照定擬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dade, when credentials of officials serving outside the capital reached the Ministry of Personnel, they were checked only at the Ministry of Justice; each person's career was entered in a conduct register and appointments were fixed by inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 1 (1297), provincial officials' credentials went to the Ministry of Personnel, with criminal records checked only at the Ministry of Justice; each career was recorded in a conduct register and appointments were decided accordingly.

sentences.zh: 凡職官回降：至元十九年，定江淮官已受宣敕，資品相應，例升二等遷去。

translations.literal: As for officials' demotion upon return: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, it was fixed that Jianghuai officials who had received imperial appointment edicts and whose qualifications matched were, as a rule, promoted two grades when transferred away.
translations.idiomatic: On demotion upon return from assignment: in Zhiyuan 19 it was fixed that Jianghuai officials who held imperial appointment edicts at matching rank were routinely advanced two grades when transferred out.

sentences.zh: 江淮官員依舊於江淮任用。

translations.literal: Jianghuai officials continued to be employed in Jianghuai as before.
translations.idiomatic: Jianghuai officials continued to be posted within the Jianghuai region as before.

sentences.zh: 其已考滿者，並免回降。

translations.literal: Those who had completed their examination period were all exempted from demotion upon return.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had completed their merit review were exempt from demotion upon return.

sentences.zh: 不及考者，例存一等。

translations.literal: Those who had not completed an examination period were, as a rule, retained one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had not completed a review retained one rank lower than the rule would otherwise allow.

sentences.zh: 有出身未合入流品受宣者，任回，三品擬同六品，四品擬同七品，正從五品同正八品；

translations.literal: Those with formal entry qualifications not yet fitting the flowing ranks who received appointment edicts, upon return from office: rank 3 was treated as rank 6, rank 4 as rank 7, ranks 5a and 5b as rank 8a;
translations.idiomatic: Officials with formal qualifications not yet in the regular civil ranks who held appointment edicts, upon return: rank 3 was treated as rank 6, rank 4 as rank 7, and ranks 5a/5b as rank 8a;

sentences.zh: 受敕者，正從六品同從八品，七品、八品同正從九品，正從九品同提領案牘、巡檢。

translations.literal: Those who received commission edicts: ranks 6a and 6b were treated as rank 8b, ranks 7 and 8 as ranks 9a and 9b, ranks 9a and 9b as record clerks and patrol inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: Those holding commission edicts: ranks 6a/6b were treated as rank 8b, ranks 7–8 as ranks 9a/9b, and ranks 9a/9b as record clerks or patrol inspectors.

sentences.zh: 無出身及白身人受宣者，三品同七品，四品同八品，正從五品同正九品；

translations.literal: Those without formal entry qualifications and commoners who received appointment edicts: rank 3 was treated as rank 7, rank 4 as rank 8, ranks 5a and 5b as rank 9a;
translations.idiomatic: Those without formal qualifications or commoners who held appointment edicts: rank 3 was treated as rank 7, rank 4 as rank 8, and ranks 5a/5b as rank 9a;

sentences.zh: 受敕者，正從六品同從九品，七品、八品同提領案牘、巡檢，正從九品擬院務監當官。

translations.literal: Those who received commission edicts: ranks 6a and 6b were treated as rank 9b, ranks 7 and 8 as record clerks and patrol inspectors, ranks 9a and 9b were treated as bureau supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Those holding commission edicts: ranks 6a/6b were treated as rank 9b, ranks 7–8 as record clerks or patrol inspectors, and ranks 9a/9b as bureau supervisors.

sentences.zh: 其上項有資品人員，再於接連福建、兩廣溪洞州郡任用，擬升一等。

translations.literal: The above-mentioned persons with qualifying ranks, if again employed in adjoining Fujian and the two Guang regions' stream-cave prefectures and districts, were proposed for promotion one grade.
translations.idiomatic: The above officials with qualifying ranks, if posted again in adjoining Fujian or the two Guang stream-cave prefectures, were to advance one rank.

sentences.zh: 兩廣、福建，別議升轉。

translations.literal: The two Guang regions and Fujian were discussed separately for promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion rules for the two Guang regions and Fujian were considered separately.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，都省未註江淮官已前，創立官府，招撫百姓，實有勞績者，其見受職名，若應受宣者，三品同七品，四品、五品擬同八品；

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan, before the Secretariat registered Jianghuai officials, those who had established government offices and pacified the people with real merit: their current titles, if they should receive appointment edicts, rank 3 was treated as rank 7, ranks 4 and 5 as rank 8;
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 14 (1277), for officials who before central registration had founded offices and pacified the populace with real merit: if entitled to appointment edicts, rank 3 was treated as rank 7 and ranks 4–5 as rank 8;

sentences.zh: 若應受敕者，正從六品同正從九品，其七品、八品擬同提控案牘、巡檢，正從九品擬同院務監當官。

translations.literal: If they should receive commission edicts, ranks 6a and 6b were treated as ranks 9a and 9b; ranks 7 and 8 were treated as record clerks and patrol inspectors; ranks 9a and 9b were treated as bureau supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: If entitled to commission edicts, ranks 6a/6b were treated as ranks 9a/9b, ranks 7–8 as record clerks or patrol inspectors, and ranks 9a/9b as bureau supervisors.

sentences.zh: 無出身不應敘白身人，其見受職名，應受宣者，三品同八品，四品、五品同九品；

translations.literal: Those without formal entry qualifications who should not be entered in the roster as commoners: their current titles, if they should receive appointment edicts, rank 3 was treated as rank 8, ranks 4 and 5 as rank 9;
translations.idiomatic: Commoners without formal qualifications not eligible for regular promotion: if entitled to appointment edicts, rank 3 was treated as rank 8 and ranks 4–5 as rank 9;

sentences.zh: 應受敕者，正從六品同提控案牘、巡檢，七品以下擬院務監當官。

translations.literal: If they should receive commission edicts, ranks 6a and 6b were treated as record clerks and patrol inspectors; rank 7 and below were treated as bureau supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: If entitled to commission edicts, ranks 6a/6b were treated as record clerks or patrol inspectors, and rank 7 and below as bureau supervisors.

sentences.zh: 其上項人員，若再於接連福建、兩廣溪洞州郡任用，擬升一等。

translations.literal: The above-mentioned persons, if again employed in adjoining Fujian and the two Guang regions' stream-cave prefectures and districts, were proposed for promotion one grade.
translations.idiomatic: The above officials, if posted again in adjoining Fujian or the two Guang stream-cave prefectures, were to advance one rank.

sentences.zh: 兩廣、福建，別議升轉。

translations.literal: The two Guang regions and Fujian were discussed separately for promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion rules for the two Guang regions and Fujian were considered separately.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年已後，新收撫州郡、準上例定奪。

translations.literal: After the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan, newly pacified prefectures and districts were decided according to the above precedents.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhiyuan 14, newly pacified prefectures and districts were governed by the precedents above.

sentences.zh: 前資不應又升二等遷去江淮官員，任回，擬定前資合得品級，於上例升二等，止於江淮遷轉，若於腹裏任用，並依上例。

translations.literal: Jianghuai officials whose prior qualifications did not qualify them yet who had been promoted two grades and transferred away: upon return from office, their prior qualifications' proper rank was fixed; on the above precedents they were promoted two grades, limited to transfers within Jianghuai; if employed in the interior regions, all followed the above precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Jianghuai officials whose prior rank did not qualify them but who had been advanced two grades and transferred out: upon return, their proper prior rank was fixed and they received two grades under the above rules, limited to Jianghuai transfers; interior postings followed the same rules.

sentences.zh: 七品以下，已歷三品、四品者，比附上項有出身未入流品人員例，從一高。

translations.literal: Rank 7 and below who had already served at ranks 3 and 4 were compared to the above precedent for persons with formal entry not yet in the flowing ranks, one grade higher.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of rank 7 and below who had previously served at ranks 3 or 4 were treated one rank higher than the precedent for qualified officials not yet in the regular civil ranks.

sentences.zh: 前三件於見擬資品上增一等銓註。

translations.literal: The first three categories received one grade added on their proposed qualifying rank for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The first three categories received one additional rank on their proposed qualifying grade at appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，詔：「軍官轉入民職，已受宣敕不曾之任者，擬自準定資品換授，從禮任月日為始，理算資考升轉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, an edict stated: 'Military officers transferring to civil office who had received appointment edicts but had not taken up the post were to be reassigned at their approved qualifying rank, counting from the date of ceremonial assumption of office, and seniority and examinations were calculated for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, an edict stated: “Military officers transferring to civil office who had received appointment edicts but had not taken up the post were to be reassigned at their approved qualifying rank, counting from the date of ceremonial assumption of office, and seniority and examinations were calculated for promotion.

sentences.zh: 若先受宣敕已經禮任，資品相應者，通理月日升轉外，據驟升人員前任所歷月日除一考外，余月日與後任月日依準定資品通理升轉，不及考者，擬自準定資品換授，從禮任月日為始，理算資考升轉。

translations.literal: If they had first received appointment edicts and had already ceremonially assumed office with matching qualifications, besides counting months in total for promotion, for persons rapidly promoted the months of their prior post except one examination period, the remaining months together with months of the later post were counted in total for promotion at the approved qualifying rank; those not completing an examination period were reassigned at their approved qualifying rank, counting from the date of ceremonial assumption, and seniority and examinations were calculated for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: If they had first received appointment edicts and had already ceremonially assumed office with matching qualifications, besides counting months in total for promotion, for persons rapidly promoted the months of their prior post except one examination period, the remaining months together with months of the later post were counted in total for promotion at the approved qualifying rank; those not completing an examination period were reassigned at their approved qualifying rank, counting from the date of ceremonial assumption, and seniority and examinations were calculated for promotion.

sentences.zh: 腹裏常調官，除資品相應者依例升轉外，有前資未應入流品受宣敕者，六品以下人員，照勘有無出身，依驗職事品秩，自受敕以後歷一考者，同江淮例定擬，不及考者，更升一等。

translations.literal: Regular officials of the interior regions: besides those with matching qualifications promoted according to precedent, those with prior qualifications not yet fitting the flowing ranks who received appointment edicts, personnel of rank 6 and below, after checking whether they had formal entry and verifying the rank of their duties, from after receiving the commission edict those who completed one examination period were fixed according to the Jianghuai precedent; those not completing an examination period were promoted one grade further.
translations.idiomatic: Regular officials of the interior regions: besides those with matching qualifications promoted according to precedent, those with prior qualifications not yet fitting the flowing ranks who received appointment edicts, personnel of rank 6 and below, after checking whether they had formal entry and verifying the rank of their duties, from after receiving the commission edict those who completed one examination period were fixed according to the Jianghuai precedent; those not completing an examination period were promoted one grade further.

sentences.zh: 五品以上人員，斟酌比附議擬，呈省據在前已經除授者，任回通理定奪。」

translations.literal: Personnel of rank 5 and above were deliberated by comparison and proposed; submitted to the Secretariat; for those already appointed previously, upon return from office a comprehensive decision was made.'
translations.idiomatic: Personnel of rank 5 and above were deliberated by comparison and proposed; submitted to the Secretariat; for those already appointed previously, upon return from office a comprehensive decision was made.”

sentences.zh: 凡吏屬年勞差等：至元六年，吏部呈：「省部譯史、通事，舊以一百二十月出職，今案牘繁冗，合以九十月為滿。」

translations.literal: As for clerical staff seniority and grades: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan, the Ministry of Personnel submitted: 'Secretariat and ministry interpreters and liaison officers formerly left office after one hundred twenty months; now because documents are numerous and burdensome, it is appropriate to set ninety months as completion.'
translations.idiomatic: As for clerical staff seniority and grades: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan, the Ministry of Personnel submitted: “Secretariat and ministry interpreters and liaison officers formerly left office after one hundred twenty months; now because documents are numerous and burdensome, it is appropriate to set ninety months as completion.”

sentences.zh: 十九年，部擬：「行省通事、譯史、令史、宣使或經例革替罷，所歷月日不等，如元經省掾發去，不及一考者，擬令貼補；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the ministry proposed: 'Provincial liaison officers, interpreters, clerks, and envoys who had been abolished or replaced under precedent had unequal months served; if originally sent from secretariat clerks and not completing one examination period, they were proposed to be supplemented;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, the ministry proposed: “Provincial liaison officers, interpreters, clerks, and envoys who had been abolished or replaced under precedent had unequal months served; if originally sent from secretariat clerks and not completing one examination period, they were proposed to be supplemented;

sentences.zh: 及一考之上者，比臺院令史出身例定奪。

translations.literal: Those of one examination period and above were decided by comparison to the precedent for Censorate and court clerks' entry qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: Those of one examination period and above were decided by comparison to the precedent for Censorate and court clerks' entry qualifications.

sentences.zh: 自行踏逐者，降一等敘，不及一考者，發還本省區用。

translations.literal: Those recruited on their own initiative were entered one grade lower; those not completing one examination period were sent back for use within their province.
translations.idiomatic: Those recruited on their own initiative were entered one grade lower; those not completing one examination period were sent back for use within their province.

sentences.zh: 宣慰司人吏，經省院發，不及一考者，擬貼補；

translations.literal: Personnel of pacification commissions sent from the Secretariat and court, not completing one examination period, were proposed to be supplemented;
translations.idiomatic: Personnel of pacification commissions sent from the Secretariat and court, not completing one examination period, were proposed to be supplemented;

sentences.zh: 及一考之上者，比部令史出身降一等定奪。

translations.literal: Those of one examination period and above were decided by comparison to ministry clerks' entry qualifications, one grade lower.
translations.idiomatic: Those of one examination period and above were decided by comparison to ministry clerks' entry qualifications, one grade lower.

sentences.zh: 自行踏逐者，又降一等；

translations.literal: Those recruited on their own initiative were lowered one grade further;
translations.idiomatic: Those recruited on their own initiative were lowered one grade further;

sentences.zh: 不及一考者，別無定奪。」

translations.literal: Those not completing one examination period had no separate decision.'
translations.idiomatic: Those not completing one examination period had no separate decision.”

sentences.zh: 二十年，省擬：「雲南行省極邊重地令譯史人等，六十月考滿。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the province proposed: 'Clerks, interpreters, and others of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat in extremely remote border regions complete examination after sixty months.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, the province proposed: “Clerks, interpreters, and others of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat in extremely remote border regions complete examination after sixty months.

sentences.zh: 甘肅行省令譯史人等，六十五月考滿，本土人員，依舊例用。」

translations.literal: Clerks, interpreters, and others of the Gansu Branch Secretariat complete examination after sixty-five months; native personnel are employed according to the old precedent.'
translations.idiomatic: Clerks, interpreters, and others of the Gansu Branch Secretariat complete examination after sixty-five months; native personnel are employed according to the old precedent.”

sentences.zh: 二十五年，省準：「緬中行省令史，依雲南行省一體出身。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the province approved: 'Clerks of the Burma Branch Secretariat follow the Yunnan Branch Secretariat as one body for entry qualifications.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, the province approved: “Clerks of the Burma Branch Secretariat follow the Yunnan Branch Secretariat as one body for entry qualifications.”

sentences.zh: 大德元年，省臣奏：「以省、臺、院諸衙門令譯史、通事、知印、宣使等，舊以九十月為滿，升遷太驟，今以一百二十月為滿，於應得職事內升用。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dade, provincial ministers memorialized: 'Because clerks, interpreters, liaison officers, seal keepers, and envoys of the various offices of the Secretariat, Censorate, and courts formerly completed service at ninety months and were promoted too rapidly, now one hundred twenty months is set as completion, and they are promoted within the posts they qualify for.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dade, provincial ministers memorialized: “Because clerks, interpreters, liaison officers, seal keepers, and envoys of the various offices of the Secretariat, Censorate, and courts formerly completed service at ninety months and were promoted too rapidly, now one hundred twenty months is set as completion, and they are promoted within the posts they qualify for.

sentences.zh: 又寫聖旨、掌奏事選法、應辦刑名文字必阇赤等，以八月折十月，今後毋令折算。」

translations.literal: Also those who wrote imperial edicts, managed memorial selection, and bituqchi who handled criminal documents counted eight months as ten; hereafter they must not be converted.'
translations.idiomatic: Also those who wrote imperial edicts, managed memorial selection, and bituqchi who handled criminal documents counted eight months as ten; hereafter they must not be converted.”

sentences.zh: 四年，制以諸衙門令譯史、宣使人等一百二十月為滿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, a regulation set clerks, interpreters, envoys, and others of the various offices at one hundred twenty months as completion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 a regulation set all office clerks, interpreters, and envoys at 120 months' completion.

sentences.zh: 部議：「遠方令譯史人等，甘肅、福建、四川於此發去，九十月為滿。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated: 'Clerks, interpreters, and others in distant regions sent from Gansu, Fujian, and Sichuan complete service at ninety months.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated: “Clerks, interpreters, and others in distant regions sent from Gansu, Fujian, and Sichuan complete service at ninety months.

sentences.zh: 兩廣、海北海南道於此發去，八十月滿，雲南省八十月滿。

translations.literal: Those sent from the two Guang regions and the Haibei Hainan Circuit complete at eighty months; Yunnan Province completes at eighty months.
translations.idiomatic: Those sent from the two Guang regions and the Haibei Hainan Circuit complete at eighty months; Yunnan Province completes at eighty months.

sentences.zh: 土人一百二十月滿。」

translations.literal: Native personnel complete at one hundred twenty months.'
translations.idiomatic: Native personnel complete at one hundred twenty months.”

sentences.zh: 都省議：「俱以九十月為考滿，土人依例一百二十月為滿。」

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated: 'All complete examination at ninety months; native personnel according to precedent complete at one hundred twenty months.'
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat deliberated: “All complete examination at ninety months; native personnel according to precedent complete at one hundred twenty months.”

sentences.zh: 至大元年，部議：「和林行省即系遠方，其人吏比四川、甘肅行省九十月出職。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhida, the ministry deliberated: 'The Karakorum Branch Secretariat is a distant region; its personnel leave office after ninety months like the Sichuan and Gansu branch secretariats.'

translations.literal: An edict ordered that new regulations be deliberated and implemented anew, and that redundancy and abuse not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered fresh regulations drafted and enforced, with care taken to prevent abuse and redundancy.

sentences.zh: 禮部從新分立等第：正從一品封贈三代，爵國公，勛正上柱國，從柱國母、妻並國夫人。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites newly established separate grades: ranks 1a and 1b posthumously enfeoff three generations, enfeoff as State Duke, honorary title Primary Senior Chief Pillar of State, Secondary Chief Pillar of State; mother and wife both State Lady.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites set new grades: ranks 1a and 1b could enfeoff three generations as State Duke, with the Primary Senior or Secondary Chief Pillar of State as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title State Lady.

sentences.zh: 正從二品封贈二代，爵郡公，勛正上護軍，從護軍，母、妻並郡夫人。

translations.literal: Ranks 2a and 2b posthumously enfeoff two generations, enfeoff as Commandery Duke, honorary title Primary Senior Guardian General, Secondary Guardian General; mother and wife both Commandery Lady.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 2a and 2b could enfeoff two generations as Commandery Duke, with the Primary Senior or Secondary Guardian General as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title Commandery Lady.

sentences.zh: 正從三品封贈二代，爵郡侯，勛正上輕車都尉，從輕車都尉母、妻並郡夫人。

translations.literal: Ranks 3a and 3b posthumously enfeoff two generations, enfeoff as Commandery Marquis, honorary title Primary Senior Charioteer Commandant, Secondary Charioteer Commandant; mother and wife both Commandery Lady.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 3a and 3b could enfeoff two generations as Commandery Marquis, with the Primary Senior or Secondary Charioteer Commandant as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title Commandery Lady.

sentences.zh: 正從四品封贈父母，爵郡伯，勛正上騎都尉，從騎都尉，母、妻並郡君。

translations.literal: Ranks 4a and 4b posthumously enfeoff parents, enfeoff as Commandery Earl, honorary title Primary Senior Cavalry Commandant, Secondary Cavalry Commandant; mother and wife both Commandery Lady of Lower Grade.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 4a and 4b could enfeoff parents as Commandery Earl, with the Primary Senior or Secondary Cavalry Commandant as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title Commandery Lady of Lower Grade.

sentences.zh: 正五品封贈父母，爵縣子，勛驍騎尉，母、妻並縣君。

translations.literal: Rank 5a posthumously enfeoff parents, enfeoff as County Viscount, honorary title Valiant Cavalry Commandant; mother and wife both County Lady of Lower Grade.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 5a could enfeoff parents as County Viscount, with the Valiant Cavalry Commandant as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title County Lady of Lower Grade.

sentences.zh: 從五品封贈父母，爵縣男，勛飛騎尉，母、妻並縣君。

translations.literal: Rank 5b posthumously enfeoff parents, enfeoff as County Baron, honorary title Flying Cavalry Commandant; mother and wife both County Lady of Lower Grade.
translations.idiomatic: Rank 5b could enfeoff parents as County Baron, with the Flying Cavalry Commandant as honorary title; mother and wife both received the title County Lady of Lower Grade.

sentences.zh: 正從六品封贈父母，父止用散官，母、妻並恭人。

translations.literal: Ranks 6a and 6b posthumously enfeoff parents; the father receives only honorary rank; mother and wife both Lady of Respect.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 6a and 6b could enfeoff parents, but the father received only an honorary rank; mother and wife both received the title Lady of Respect.

sentences.zh: 正從七品封贈父母，父止用散官，母、妻並宜人。

translations.literal: Ranks 7a and 7b posthumously enfeoff parents; the father receives only honorary rank; mother and wife both Lady of Propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 7a and 7b could enfeoff parents, but the father received only an honorary rank; mother and wife both received the title Lady of Propriety.

sentences.zh: 正從一品至五品宣授，六品至七品敕牒。

translations.literal: Ranks 1a through 5b receive formal imperial patents; ranks 6 through 7 receive decree documents.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks 1a through 5b received formal imperial patents; ranks 6 through 7 received decree documents.

sentences.zh: 如應封贈三代者，曾祖父母一道，祖父母一道，父母一道，生者各另給降。

translations.literal: If entitled to posthumous enfeoffment of three generations, one patent for great-grandparents, one for grandparents, one for parents; living persons each receive separate patents at reduced rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those entitled to enfeoff three generations received one patent each for great-grandparents, grandparents, and parents; living recipients each received a separate patent at a reduced rank.

sentences.zh: 封贈者，一品至五品並用散官勛爵，六品七品止用散官職事，從一高。

translations.literal: For those enfeoffed, ranks 1 through 5 use both honorary rank and merit titles; ranks 6 and 7 use only honorary rank and substantive office, following whichever is higher.
translations.idiomatic: For ranks 1 through 5, enfeoffment used both honorary rank and merit titles; for ranks 6 and 7, only honorary rank and substantive office applied, following whichever was higher.

sentences.zh: 封贈曾祖，降祖一等，祖降父一等，父母妻並與夫、子同。

translations.literal: Enfeoffing the great-grandfather lowers one grade from the grandfather; the grandfather one grade from the father; parents and wife are the same as the husband or son.
translations.idiomatic: A great-grandfather was enfeoffed one grade below the grandfather, and the grandfather one grade below the father; parents and wife received the same honors as the husband or son.

sentences.zh: 父母在仕者不封，已致仕並不在仕者封之，雖在仕棄職就封者聽。

translations.literal: Parents still in office are not enfeoffed; those who have retired or were never in office are enfeoffed; even if in office, those who abandon their post to accept enfeoffment are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Parents still holding office were not enfeoffed; those retired or never in office were; and even parents still in office could abandon their posts to accept enfeoffment if they wished.

sentences.zh: 父母應封，而讓曾祖父母、祖父母者聽。

translations.literal: If parents should be enfeoffed but one yields to great-grandparents or grandparents, it is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If parents were eligible for enfeoffment but an applicant chose instead to honor great-grandparents or grandparents, that was permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸子應封父母，嫡母在，所生之母不得封。

translations.literal: When sons should enfeoff parents, if the principal mother lives, the birth mother may not be enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: When sons enfeoffed their parents, if the principal mother was still living, the birth mother could not be enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 嫡母亡，得並封。

translations.literal: If the principal mother has died, both may be enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: If the principal mother had died, both mothers could be enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 若所生母未封贈者，不得先封其妻。

translations.literal: If the birth mother has not yet received posthumous enfeoffment, the wife may not be enfeoffed first.
translations.idiomatic: If the birth mother had not yet received posthumous honors, the wife could not be enfeoffed first.

sentences.zh: 諸職官曾受贓，不許申請，封贈之後，但犯取受之贓，並行追奪。

translations.literal: All officeholders who once took bribes may not apply; after enfeoffment, if they commit bribe-taking offenses, enfeoffment is revoked in full.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who had once taken bribes could not apply; and if after enfeoffment they committed bribery, the honors were fully revoked.

sentences.zh: 其父祖元有官進一階，不在追奪之例。

translations.literal: If the father and grandfather originally held office with one-rank advancement, they are not subject to revocation.
translations.idiomatic: Fathers and grandfathers who had originally held office with one rank of advancement were not subject to revocation.

sentences.zh: 父祖元有官者，隨其所帶文武官上封贈，若已是封贈之官，止於本等官上許進一階，階滿者更不在封贈之限。

translations.literal: If father and grandfather originally held office, enfeoff according to the civil or military rank they bore; if already enfeoffed officials, only one rank advancement is permitted on the current grade; those at maximum rank are no longer within the limits of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: If father or grandfather had originally held office, enfeoffment followed the civil or military rank they had borne; if already enfeoffed, only one further rank was permitted at that grade, and those at the maximum rank were no longer eligible.

sentences.zh: 〈（如子官至四品，其父祖已帶四品上階之類。）〉

translations.literal: (if the son's office reaches rank 4, his father and grandfather already bear upper-grade rank 4, and the like.)
translations.idiomatic: (if the son reached rank 4, his father and grandfather might already bear upper-grade rank 4, and the like.)

sentences.zh: 或兩子當封者，從一高。

translations.literal: If two sons are both eligible to enfeoff, follow whichever is higher.
translations.idiomatic: If two sons were both eligible to enfeoff, the higher rank prevailed.

sentences.zh: 文武不同者，從所請。

translations.literal: If civil and military ranks differ, follow what is requested.
translations.idiomatic: If civil and military ranks differed, the applicant's request prevailed.

sentences.zh: 婦人因其夫、子封贈，而夫、子兩有官者，從一高。

translations.literal: Women enfeoffed through husband or son: if both husband and son hold office, follow whichever is higher.
translations.idiomatic: Women enfeoffed through husband or son followed the higher rank when both husband and son held office.

sentences.zh: 封贈曾祖母、祖母並母，生封並加太字，若已亡歿或曾祖、祖父、父在者，不加太字。

translations.literal: Enfeoffing great-grandmother, grandmother, and mother: living enfeoffment adds the prefix "Grand"; if already deceased or if great-grandfather, grandfather, or father still live, the prefix "Grand" is not added.
translations.idiomatic: When enfeoffing a great-grandmother, grandmother, or mother while she was still living, the prefix "Grand" was added; if she was already deceased, or if the great-grandfather, grandfather, or father still lived, it was not.

sentences.zh: 職官居喪，應封贈曾祖父母、祖父母、父母者聽。

translations.literal: Officeholders in mourning who should enfeoff great-grandparents, grandparents, or parents are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Officeholders in mourning were permitted to enfeoff great-grandparents, grandparents, or parents when eligible.

sentences.zh: 其應受封之人，居曾祖父母、祖父母、父母、舅姑、夫喪者，服闋申請。

translations.literal: Those who should receive enfeoffment but are in mourning for great-grandparents, grandparents, parents, parents-in-law, or husband apply after mourning ends.
translations.idiomatic: Those eligible to receive enfeoffment but in mourning for great-grandparents, grandparents, parents, parents-in-law, or a husband had to wait until mourning ended before applying.

sentences.zh: 應封贈者，有使遠死節，有臨陳死事者，驗事特議加封。

translations.literal: Those eligible for enfeoffment who died maintaining integrity on distant missions or died in battle—the facts are verified and special deliberation adds enhanced enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Those eligible for enfeoffment who died maintaining integrity on distant missions or fell in battle were investigated and considered for enhanced honors.

sentences.zh: 應封妻者，止封正妻一人，如正妻已歿，繼室亦止封一人，余不在封贈之例。

translations.literal: Those eligible to enfeoff a wife enfeoff only one principal wife; if the principal wife has died, only one successor wife is enfeoffed; others are not within the precedent of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Only one principal wife could be enfeoffed; if she had died, only one successor wife could be enfeoffed. Others were not eligible.

sentences.zh: 婦人因夫、子得封者，不許再嫁，如不遵守，將所受宣敕追奪，斷罪離異。

translations.literal: Women enfeoffed through husband or son may not remarry; if they do not comply, the imperial patents they received are revoked and they are sentenced to divorce.
translations.idiomatic: Women enfeoffed through husband or son were forbidden to remarry; violators had their patents revoked and were sentenced to divorce.

sentences.zh: 父祖曾任三品以上官，亡歿，生前有勛勞，為上知遇者，子孫雖不仕，具實跡赴所在官司保結申請，驗事跡可否，量擬封贈。

translations.literal: If father or grandfather once held rank 3 or above, is deceased, had meritorious service in life, and enjoyed imperial favor, descendants though not in office may submit verified records to local authorities for certification and apply; the facts are verified for feasibility and enfeoffment is measured and proposed.
translations.idiomatic: If a father or grandfather who had once held rank 3 or above died after meritorious service and imperial favor, descendants who did not hold office could submit verified records to local authorities for certification; the facts would be investigated and enfeoffment measured accordingly.

sentences.zh: 無後者，許有司保結申請。

translations.literal: Those without descendants are permitted to have officials certify and apply.
translations.idiomatic: Those without descendants were permitted to have officials certify and apply on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 曾祖父母、祖父母、父母曾犯十惡奸盜除名等罪，及例所封妻不是以禮娶到正室，或系再醮倡優婢妾，並不許申請。

translations.literal: Great-grandparents, grandparents, and parents who once committed the Ten Abominations, adultery, theft, dismissal, and the like, and wives eligible for enfeoffment who were not principal wives properly married by ritual, or who were remarried women, actresses, concubines, or maids—all may not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Applications were barred when great-grandparents, grandparents, or parents had committed the Ten Abominations, adultery, theft, or dismissal; or when the wife to be enfeoffed was not a principal wife properly married by ritual, or was a remarried woman, actress, concubine, or maid.

sentences.zh: 凡告請封贈者，隨朝並京官行省、行臺、宣慰司、廉訪司見任官，各於任所申請。

translations.literal: All who petition for enfeoffment—court-attending and capital officials, branch secretariat, branch censorate, pacification commission, and surveillance commission incumbents—each apply at their post.
translations.idiomatic: All who petitioned for enfeoffment—court-attending and capital officials, and incumbents of branch secretariats, branch censorates, pacification commissions, and surveillance commissions—applied at their posts.

sentences.zh: 其餘官員，見任並已除未任，至得替日，隨其解由申請。

translations.literal: Other officials, whether incumbent or appointed but not yet serving, upon the day of replacement apply with their discharge documents.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials, whether incumbent or appointed but not yet serving, applied with their discharge documents upon the day of replacement.

sentences.zh: 致仕官於所在官司申請。

translations.literal: Retired officials apply at the local office where they reside.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials applied at the local office where they resided.

sentences.zh: 正從七品至正從六品，止封一次。

translations.literal: From ranks 7a and 7b through ranks 6a and 6b, enfeoff only once.
translations.idiomatic: From ranks 7 through 6, enfeoffment was permitted only once.

sentences.zh: 升至正從五品，封贈一次。

translations.literal: Upon promotion to ranks 5a and 5b, enfeoff once.
translations.idiomatic: Upon promotion to rank 5, one further enfeoffment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 升至正從四品，封贈一次。

translations.literal: Upon promotion to ranks 4a and 4b, enfeoff once.
translations.idiomatic: Upon promotion to rank 4, one further enfeoffment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 升至正從三品，封贈一次。

translations.literal: Upon promotion to ranks 3a and 3b, enfeoff once.
translations.idiomatic: Upon promotion to rank 3, one further enfeoffment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 升至正從二品，封贈一次。

translations.literal: Upon promotion to ranks 2a and 2b, enfeoff once.
translations.idiomatic: Upon promotion to rank 2, one further enfeoffment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 升至正從一品，封贈一次。

translations.literal: Upon promotion to ranks 1a and 1b, enfeoff once.
translations.idiomatic: Upon promotion to rank 1, one further enfeoffment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 凡封贈流官父祖曾任三品以上者，許請謚。

translations.literal: For all regular officials enfeoffing fathers and grandfathers who once held rank 3 or above, requesting a posthumous epithet is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Regular officials enfeoffing a father or grandfather who had once held rank 3 or above were permitted to request a posthumous epithet.

sentences.zh: 如立朝有大節，功勛在王室者，許加功臣之號。

translations.literal: If one held great integrity at court and merit to the royal house, adding the title of meritorious minister is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had shown great integrity at court and rendered merit to the royal house were permitted to receive the title of meritorious minister.

sentences.zh: 至治三年，詔：「封贈之典，本以激勸忠孝，今後散官職事勛爵，依例加授，外任官員並許在任申請，其餘合行事理，仰各依舊制。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhizhi, an edict stated: "The rite of posthumous enfeoffment was originally meant to encourage loyalty and filial piety; hereafter honorary rank, substantive office, and merit titles are added and conferred according to precedent; officials serving outside the capital are also permitted to apply while in office; all other applicable matters are to follow the old regulations."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhizhi, an edict stated: "The rite of posthumous enfeoffment was originally meant to encourage loyalty and filial piety; hereafter honorary rank, substantive office, and merit titles are added and conferred according to precedent; officials serving outside the capital are also permitted to apply while in office; all other applicable matters are to follow the old regulations."

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，詔：「犯贓官員，不得封贈，沈郁既久，宜許自新，有能滌慮改過，再歷兩任無過者，許所管上司正官從公保明，監察御史、廉訪司覆察是實，並聽依例申請。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding, an edict stated: "Officials who committed bribery may not receive enfeoffment; they have been depressed for long and should be permitted to reform; those who can cleanse their thoughts and amend their faults, and serve two terms without fault, are permitted to have their supervising superior chief certify impartially, with surveillance censors and surveillance commissions re-investigating that the facts are true, and all are permitted to apply according to precedent."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiding, an edict stated: "Officials who committed bribery may not receive enfeoffment; they have been depressed for long and should be permitted to reform; those who can cleanse their thoughts and amend their faults, and serve two terms without fault, are permitted to have their supervising superior chief certify impartially, with surveillance censors and surveillance commissions re-investigating that the facts are true, and all are permitted to apply according to precedent."
